status: Factory quotation and CAM review only; not authorized for manufacture

pcb.outline: Use Edge.Cuts, including the left antenna recess
pcb.impedance: 90 ohm differential outer-layer USB main runs, 0.2474mm width / 0.1501mm gap. Confirm with factory; local pad escapes and short USB2 neck use narrower copper.
pcb.via_process: All electrical vias: epoxy filled and copper capped, IPC-4761 Type VII. This includes exposed-pad and other vias in or near solder lands. Soldermask tenting alone is not a substitute.
pcb.via_identification: Native KiCad source and via-fill-locations.csv distinguish vias from connector holes. Do not fill plated connector holes or NPTH locating/mounting holes.
pcb.soldermask: Both sides; no bottom silkscreen required
pcb.fabrication_quote: Four-layer via filling/capping may be an extra-charge process. Confirm capability, price, thickness tolerance and controlled impedance before release.

assembly.scope: Factory assembles all 103 PCB components, including every through-hole connector; display installation and nylon mounting hardware are additional operations.
assembly.soldering: SMT reflow followed by qualified selective/wave/manual factory THT soldering. Do not put connectors through SMT reflow without their approved temperature/time profiles.
assembly.placement: Native KiCad position/rotation data supplied. Factory must resolve its component-library rotation convention and return a placement preview for review before assembly.
assembly.polarity: Check U1/U8 exposed-pad orientation, U10/U11/U12 pin 1, Q1-Q3 pin mapping, D2 cathode, D3 LED polarity, C4 positive terminal and L1 winding polarity against drawings.
assembly.paste: Use the segmented U1 exposed-pad apertures from F.Paste. Review stencil thickness and fine-pitch apertures for the 0.4mm-pitch MCU.
assembly.connectors: J4 contacts 0.92mm finished holes, shields 2.30mm. J7 contacts 1.10mm, shields 2.30mm. Verify retention and solder fillets on 1mm board; supplier drawings control dimensions.
assembly.display: Same r6 SH1106 module; see assembly-accessories.json and original drawings. Pin order 3V3, GND, SCL, SDA. Do not substitute a GND-first module.
assembly.bom_substitutions: No substitutions without electrical and mechanical review; especially L1, connectors, clocks, flash, power mux and isolation parts.
assembly.inventory: Public stock is not allocated. Confirm all 43 codes, placement minima and attrition for the actual quantity.

models.coverage: All 103 purchased parts have models. 41 of 43 active unique part models are LCSC/EasyEDA; RM2 is official Raspberry Pi; DE9 is a detailed KiCad substitute.
models.limits: The DE9 substitute has longer pins than the purchased connector. Use supplier drawings and case clearance envelopes, not substitute pin lengths, for mechanical decisions. OLED assembly is hidden in KiCad; its connector remains visible.
